text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
King-chan, thank you for the birthday 
present! That spray... it smells so, so 
good!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! Was it the scent of Sakhalin 
fir?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"T-That's because... I rethought things in 
all sorts of ways! Because Sky-san said 
she ordered Hokkaido cola as a present."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, it's not cola, it's "guarana"~ How 
did you like it, Spe-chan?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...It felt like summer vacation back over 
there.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Surrounded by the gentle, warm fragrance 
of a Hokkaido garden. ...A chilled guarana 
drink tasted so good."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, thank you both! Once we get back to 
our room, I feel like I'm gonna relax sooo 
much again!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
No? Let's just call it a combined score 
victory.
